[stdout]
Print the link of one of your active shares, by its id from 'purlview list'.

The link is the only thing printed on standard output, so it can be piped
to the clipboard.

Usage:
  purlview link <id> [flags]

Examples:
  purlview link k7m2p4qx

Flags:
  -h, --help   Show help for link.
[stderr]
